name: nuclear factor I B

function.text: NFIB encodes nuclear factor 1 B-type. Annotated molecular activities include transcription regulator inhibitor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in negative regulation of miRNA transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); macrocephaly, acquired, with impaired intellectual development (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Basal cell carcinoma of prostate; Adenoid cystic carcinoma of breast; Pulmonary adenoid cystic carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
